name: vicuna_benchmark_indonesian
description: A Vicuna-style benchmark adapted for Indonesian that measures conversational and instruction-following quality of LLMs in Indonesian. It contains prompts and model responses intended for pairwise or human preference evaluation to assess helpfulness, correctness, and safety in Indonesian-language interactions. It is used to evaluate multilingual/Indonesian capabilities of conversational models.
evaluation_method: human_eval (pairwise preference / human rating of responses)
reputation: Derived from the Vicuna evaluation methodology; modest community use for Indonesian LLM evaluation but not a broadly standardized benchmark.
